objective: Run a read-only audit of the authorized live site's robots.txt and sitemap.xml endpoints. Repeat the checks independently, report exact HTTP/evidence results, and do not modify, commit, or deploy any website files.
constraints: Read-only network requests to the configured authorized live_url only.
Do not access credentials or secrets.
Do not infer Google indexing from endpoint availability.
Do not modify files in the target repository.
Captain review is required; automatic merge and deployment are forbidden.
success_criteria: Both primary and independent checker results are present.
Evidence from both passes matches exactly before approval.
Any failed or inconsistent check remains VERIFYING.
Report is uploaded as a workflow artifact.
